An '''officer''' served aboard the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], [[Takara (ship)|''Takara'']], in [[700 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Control has detected the unauthorized launch of a small ship from docking bay 16.|Officer of ''Takara''|<ref name="Heart of Darkness">{{Tales|16|Heart of Darkness}}</ref>}}
In [[700 BBY]], he was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Takara (ship)|''Takara'']]. He reported to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[T'dai]], when a [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader]] escaped to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. After his report, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pursued the Dark Jedi, and [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]] [[Duel on Dagobah (700 BBY)|killed]] him.
